scoring_rule: Score each completed GW (all fixtures finished, official points incl. bonus final) by deterministic replay of the frozen policies from GW10; per-GW points = cumulative(K) - cumulative(K-1). No spec or code edits after the freeze; any spec change restarts the clock and is recorded here.
known_simplifications: buys pay the target-GW deadline price (intra-week moves unmodelled)
buy candidates must be panel-present (4 trailing GW rows, >=180 trailing minutes) - eligibility bias toward established regulars
chips (WC/FH/BB/TC) are not modelled in this simulation

decision_freeze.protocol: Before each GW K deadline, `freeze --gw K --spec <this spec>` persists each policy's actual decisions (starting squad at start_gw, transfers with prices used, XI, bench order, captain/vice) into 12th-man/v2/data/frozen/decisions/gw<K>-<version>.json with frozen_at, input hashes (played-rows csv_sha256, schedule rows, saved price-snapshot file sha256 + pull time, official deadline from the events snapshot) and code blob pins. Frozen files are NEVER overwritten; corrections require a new label, not an edit. `score-gw --gw K` later applies official actuals (bonus-final, GW complete in provenance) to the frozen decisions only, appending to the version-labelled results file; re-scoring a GW is refused. freeze REFUSES to run at/after the target GW's official deadline (SystemExit naming season/GW/deadline) and refuses to run without the events or price snapshots. Prices come from the SAME saved snapshot file that is hashed - freeze never re-fetches.
decision_freeze.decision_inputs: strictly pre-outcome: played rows with gw < K; fixture SCHEDULE at K (opponents known pre-deadline); the saved price snapshot (consumed and hashed, no second fetch); prior frozen decision files. No GW-K outcome rows are required or used; decision_sql_for reproduces the frozen panel's feature semantics on schedule-anchored rows (equivalence enforced by tests/test_prospective_decisions.py on completed GWs). Fit rows are the completed train seasons only (current-season rows never enter the fit); decision rows sit only at K.
decision_freeze.decision_code: transfer decisions use bt.transfer_week, the identical code path as the replay (extracted from simulate() 31 Oct; behavior-preserving, verified by byte-identical replay output against the pre-refactor script on both holdout seasons).
decision_freeze.replay_label: `replay` (formerly `run`) reconstructs choices AFTER outcome rows exist and is a DIAGNOSTIC only; outputs land in prospective-2026-27-replay*.json, never in the prospective record.
decision_freeze.immutability: freeze refuses to overwrite an existing decision file; score-gw refuses to re-score a GW already in the results file; every decision file carries a content_sha256 self-hash verified at load.
